task_summary: Align the EStG-150 human-review gate governance after Event 21. The authoritative experiment_contract.human_review_gate.status is updated from 'paused_until_route_v2_is_locked' to 'input_ready_for_human_review' with explicit allowed/blocking status lists and a new formal_gold_publication_gate block. status.py / audit.py split the four orthogonal gates (input ready / freeze ready / formal Gold publication ready / final experiment ready) and explicitly disambiguate them. Tests cover all four gates with positive and negative state transitions. Active handoff / status docs are updated to match. The deprecated human_review_ready alias is removed from any final-metric code paths. No data modified, no real LLM/API, no .env, no references/archive changes, no commit, no Wave 2.

files_modified.role: Change human_review_gate.status to 'input_ready_for_human_review' with explicit allowed_input_statuses and blocking_input_statuses lists. Add a new top-level formal_gold_publication_gate block enumerating the five required preconditions and the conservative policy (any missing or non-locked field keeps formal_gold_publication_ready false).

Add four orthogonal gates: human_review_input_ready (gates 1), human_review_freeze_ready (gate 2), formal_gold_publication_ready (gate 3 — human_review_freeze_ready + route.locked + dataset.locked + stage3.locked + formal_gold_publication_gate.status not blocked), final_experiment_ready (gate 4 — adds method readiness and frozen input/gold). Read the authoritative contract gate status and the membership hash; if either disagrees, gate 1 is false. Mark human_review_ready as DEPRECATED alias.

Report all four gates in print_human. Replace the previous 'formal_gold_publication_paused' message so it never says 'Formal Gold can be declared' when only the annotation is frozen. Add a per-missing-precondition enumeration. Add the contract vs. preconditions mismatch error. Bump audit_version to 3.2.

Update the '当前状态' section to reflect the 4-gate state: human_review_input_ready=true (user can start), human_review_freeze_ready=false, formal_gold_publication_ready=false, final_experiment_ready=false, integrity_pass=true. Document the review tool launch command. Remove the outdated '--require-human-review-ready 应失败' claim.

Add the four orthogonal audit gates table. Replace the 'Do not touch it for formal review until a future route lock' contradictory block with the explicit gate semantics. The 150-record v2 human_correction file is the active editing surface and gate 1 is true NOW; route v2 re-lock affects gate 3 / gate 4, NOT gate 1.

Update §5.1 '启动门禁 vs 冻结门禁' to a four-gate table. Each gate has its own meaning, current value at 0/150, current value at 150/150 adjudicated, and the command that reports it. The deprecated human_review_ready alias is explicitly scoped to the --require-human-review-ready flag; new code must use the four explicit names.

Update §4.1.1 with the four-gate table and the deprecated-alias warning. Clarify the three commands (--require-human-review-ready / --require-final-ready / validate_human_correction.py) and which gate each one checks.

Update the §11 '机器状态' line to report the four gates (input / freeze / formal Gold / final experiment) with current 0/150 values, instead of the old 'human_review_ready=false / final_experiment_ready=false' two-bool summary that was inconsistent with the actual audit.

Replace the obsolete two-bool summary (human_review_ready=false / final_experiment_ready=false) with the four-gate summary and add a notice that the snapshot semantics have been upgraded by the 2026-07-13 4-gate split (Event 21/22).

Add a SUPERSEDED banner at the very top (no historical content is modified) pointing future agents to the four-gate active sources (ROUTE_LOCK.md §5.1, HUMAN_GOLD_GUIDE.md §4.1.1, CURRENT_HANDOFF, AUDIT_LOG, AUDIT_EVENTS.jsonl). The original 14:55 historical content stays intact below the banner.

Replace the previous 12-test file with a 17-test file covering all four gates with positive and negative state transitions: (1) all four booleans at 0/150, (2) --require-human-review-ready passes, (3) --require-final-ready fails, (4) input gate false on missing schema, (5) input gate false on missing tool/validator, (6) input gate false on sample_id / membership mismatch, (7) input gate false when contract.status is paused, (8) freeze_ready=true but formal_gold_publication_paused is still present and the message never says 'Formal Gold can be declared', (9) formal_gold_publication_ready only true when all five locks are met, (10) conservative false when only one of the five locks is true, (11) no formal runner or final-metric code uses the deprecated alias, (12) validator CLI still shows review_ready / freeze_ready false at 0/150, plus four pre-existing governance tests.

1_human_review_input_ready.meaning: the user can start the human review NOW
true_when: v2 human_correction file exists and is format-valid with exactly 150 unique sample_ids
v1 canonical review file is format-valid with exactly 150 unique sample_ids
membership_payload_sha256 of the v2 file matches the locked membership

2_human_review_freeze_ready.true_when: every record has review_state.status == 'adjudicated' and every decision is in {accepted, edited, rejected}

3_formal_gold_publication_ready.meaning: formal Gold can be declared and published
true_when: experiment_contract.formal_gold_publication_gate.status does NOT start with 'blocked_' and is not 'unknown'
3_formal_gold_publication_ready.conservative_policy: any missing or non-locked field keeps this gate false; do not guess; do not relax

4_final_experiment_ready.meaning: the three final methods + Stage 3 + frozen input/gold can run end-to-end
true_when: all three methods in methods.json have formal_status == 'ready'
data/input/ has at least one non-.gitkeep file (frozen input)
data/gold/ has at least one non-.gitkeep file (frozen gold)

workflow_invariants_enforced: Four orthogonal readiness gates: human_review_input_ready (gate 1, true at 0/150 once the input is ready), human_review_freeze_ready (gate 2, true at 150/150 adjudicated), formal_gold_publication_ready (gate 3, true only when gate 2 AND route/dataset/stage3/freeze_policy are all re-locked), final_experiment_ready (gate 4, adds method readiness and frozen input/gold).

Authoritative contract gate: experiment_contract.human_review_gate.status is the source of truth for the input-gate policy. The audit reads the contract and the membership cross-check; it does NOT silently ignore them.

Conservative formal Gold policy: any missing or non-locked field of the five formal-gold preconditions keeps formal_gold_publication_ready false. The audit message never says 'Formal Gold can be declared' when only the annotation is frozen.

Deprecated alias discipline: human_review_ready is kept as a backward-compatible alias of human_review_input_ready (true at 0/150) ONLY for the --require-human-review-ready flag. New code that needs 'ready to publish Gold' must use human_review_freeze_ready / formal_gold_publication_ready / final_experiment_ready. A test scans formal_experiment/ for any other consumer.
Single 150 sample_id set: the EStG-150 dataset is the project-self-sampled 150 (NOT Sun's original 150, NOT exact-reproduction). membership_payload_sha256 is unchanged at 8573e105...0d7.
No resampling, no parallel old/new 150: layer A/B/C/D SHA-256 unchanged; the user-decision block in experiment_contract.json records the explicit 2026-07-13 decisions.
Chinese aid not generated: Layer D fields are all null; the review_aids_zh_not_generated warning is still emitted; no Chinese content is fabricated.
No real LLM/API: no test, tool, or audit call invokes an LLM or reads .env. The audit module's imports are scanned for forbidden tokens (requests, httpx, openai, LLMClient, load_dotenv).
No event 1-21 modified: the new audit event is appended as event 22; historical events are byte-identical.

audit_invariants.new_event_purpose: Align the EStG-150 human-review gate governance after Event 21: make the authoritative contract explicitly permit starting review at 0/150, separate annotation freeze readiness from formal Gold publication readiness, keep route/data prerequisites conservative, update active handoff/status documentation, and add positive/negative gate-transition tests; no data modified and no real LLM/API call.
